caption: Start from a built-in Persona
line: A Persona is one reusable agent profile. Open Settings, Agents and Automation, Personas. Start from a built-in: right-click it and choose Duplicate. Or press New persona to start from scratch.

caption: Name, model level, instructions
line: Open your copy. Give it a name and a one-line description. Leave the harness neutral, so it follows whichever tool you launch with. Set a model level, then add standing instructions in the system prompt. Save it.

caption: Duplicate a built-in Squad
line: A Squad is a group of Personas. The easiest start is a copy of a built-in. Right-click a Squad in Settings, Squads, and choose Duplicate.

caption: Slots and the Orchestrator
line: Open your copy. Each slot is one Persona and a tab count. Add a slot and choose your new Persona. The crown marks the Orchestrator, which every run needs.

caption: Launch options
line: Below the slots are the launch options. Default planning sets the planning mode. Launch approval can require your review before an agent starts the Squad. Worktree isolation and When a run finishes decide what happens to the checkout. Then save.

caption: Set as default
line: To have the composer preselect your Squad, right-click it and choose Set as default.

caption: Personas are parts, Squads are groups
line: Personas are the parts. A Squad is the group you launch.
